title: Request Flow (LLM)
description: End-to-end flow of an LLM request across the three log planes. Proxy side (nginx-access-*): requests/latency per upstream instance — upstream_addr is ip:port and the port IS the llama-server instance. Body plane (nginx-body-*): captured JSON API traffic, linked 1:1 to access records by request_id. Backend side (llm-logs-*): completions and throughput per instance. To trace one request: find it in the ingress panels (time + instance), then read the backend panels for the same instance and time window — with -np 1 there is exactly one llama task per instance per window.
